title: Baghor sunle zamana
body:
baghor sun le zamana hussain aise thay
baqa fana ko banaya hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
churi ke neeche wo khaliq se pyar ki baatein
ajal ko ho gaya sakta hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
mukhalifat pe zamana tha us taraf lekin
wohi kiya jo kaha tha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
sipahe shaam shujaat ka loha maan gayi
dabe na laakhon se tanha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar ko baandh ke peeri may jalti reti se
uthaya bete ka laasha hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
jawan ki laash uthayi banayi qabre sagheer
kahin bhi azm na badla hussain aise thay
<<DIVIDER>>
hazar shukr ke sajday shaheed karta hay
banaya qatre ko darya hussain aise thay
author: Shaheed Lakhnavi
